result.summary: The promotional banner has a significant text-contrast issue. No other clear visual defects are apparent.

issues.description: The white headline and offer details on the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast, making the promotion and checkout code difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green text or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements: at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
